title: Incident
description: One publicly reported security incident affecting an organization. Small on purpose: every field must be fillable from public text, and 'unknown' is always allowed.

id.description: sha1 of normalized org_name + disclosed_date (YYYY-MM). Stable across runs so re-runs update rather than duplicate.

org_type.description: Coarse sector. Maps roughly onto VERIS victim.industry at the 2-digit NAICS level; kept to ~12 buckets so counts are meaningful.

disclosed_date.description: Date the incident became public (filing date, notice date, article date). Always known.

incident_date.description: Date the intrusion began or was discovered, if stated. Null if not stated.

initial_access.description: How the attacker (or error) got in. Aligned to ATT&CK Initial Access (TA0001) plus non-attack causes. 'unknown' is the expected value for most regulator-only records.

initial_access_attack_id.description: ATT&CK technique ID if one clearly applies (e.g. T1566, T1078, T1190, T1195, T1133). Null otherwise.

veris_action.description: VERIS action category, for comparability with DBIR.

root_cause.description: One plain sentence on the underlying weakness, only if the source states or clearly implies it (e.g. 'Long-lived OAuth token for a third-party integration was not rotated after a prior compromise'). Null if the source doesn't say.

technology_involved.description: Named vendors, products or categories that were the point of entry or the system breached (e.g. 'Salesforce', 'Okta SSO', 'GitHub Actions', 'Citrix NetScaler', 'VPN appliance', 'email'). Empty if none named.

records_affected.description: Individuals or records affected, only if a number is stated. Null otherwise. Never estimate.

threat_actor.description: Group name if attributed or claimed (e.g. 'ShinyHunters', 'Qilin'). Null otherwise.

evidence_level.description: Strongest form of evidence among the sources. Order: org_confirmed > regulator_filing > press_report > actor_claimed.

confidence.description: Extractor's confidence that initial_access and root_cause are supported by the text.

supporting_quote.description: Verbatim sentence from the source that supports initial_access / root_cause. Required when initial_access != unknown. Used for spot-checking hallucination.

summary.description: One neutral sentence: who, what was accessed, how (if known).

reviewed.description: True once a human has checked the record. Unreviewed records are shown with a flag on the site.

schema_version.description: Bump the minor on additive enum changes, the major on anything that breaks comparability. Log every change in docs/CHANGELOG.md.

imported_from.description: Set on records imported from an existing coded dataset rather than extracted here. Keeps provenance and license obligations attached to the record.
